turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I'm Meredith Kalinowski, Owen's mother. I have until 4:40, and I'd like the zero withdrawn.
I should have called you before I entered that zero. I didn't. I'm sorry, and Owen deserved better than finding out on his phone.
Okay. Now show me the document you based the zero on, with the times on it.
Version history: created October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. 11:52, 612 words in one edit. 11:58, 794 words in one edit. Then 23 minutes of formatting. Here's the printout.
Turn it toward me. Eleven fifty-two, six hundred words in one edit. Who pasted that, and where did it come from?

His October 15 outline argued Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice. And on November 2 I asked him what epistemological paralysis means; he said 'like, being stuck', and couldn't name the scene for paragraph two. My notes from that day.
"Like, being stuck." Write that down, Hale. I'm writing down the October 15 outline and the November 2 date too. Is that the whole of what you have, or is there more I'll be reading tomorrow?

The essay quotes 3.2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Not in the play. Here's the Folger search, zero hits. And his September 24 in-class piece: 380 words, 62%, comma splices, no quotations. The essay: nine cited quotations, clean.
Show me the Folger search. Turn the screen, and let me see the query and the result count yourself.

Screen's turned. Query 'kingdom in exile', zero results. My offer: a supervised rewrite, first concern, under our procedure. Private. If it holds up, his new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record.

"Put it to Owen's rewrite, not his cheating. I'll agree to a supervised rewrite, but only if it's private and not in front of his class. Send me the terms in writing tonight, with 'nothing goes on his record' in the first line, and copy the principal."

Agreed on all of it. Zero comes off today, private rewrite, nothing on his file, in an email to you and the principal by six tonight. That's everything I have. Thank you for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
"Okay. Six tonight, in writing, copied to the principal. And Owen's name stays out of any room with his class in it. Thank you, Hale."
Have a good evening. I'll send it by six.
Okay. I'll be checking my inbox at six.
